final:
format_log(level: str, message: str) -> str =
  pre level.char_count() > 0
  post out == "[\(level)] \(message)"
  ex format_log("INFO", "server started") == "[INFO] server started"
  "[\(level)] \(message)"

log_line(level: str, message: str) uses io =
  pre level.char_count() > 0
  io.print(format_log(level, message))
